note: Clinton County IN zoning districts appear only in vendor viewers (Schneider Beacon 'Clinton County Zoning' layer, which returns 403 bot-check to our reader; FetchGIS 'County Zoning' viewer layer with no public service URL exposed). No public ArcGIS REST/WFS/bulk zoning polygon layer was found via arcgis search (state and county boxes), web search, or the county's GIS host (gis.clintonco.com did not respond). Frankfort city zoning is also PDF-only.
